roadmap.title: DMC1 Normal, collectibles, and story
roadmap.description: Complete DMC1 on Normal while clearing all 12 Secret Missions, collecting Blue Orbs and guns, buying Dante's actions, and recording Normal-only Enemy File behavior.

roadmap.title: DMC1 Hard, Dante Must Die, and cleanup
roadmap.description: Carry the same DMC1 save through Hard and Dante Must Die, finish the no-Yellow-Orb run, fill the Enemy Files, and complete remaining rank and Red Orb goals.

roadmap.title: DMC2 Dante and Lucia Normal routes
roadmap.description: Clear both DMC2 Normal campaigns while following their separate collectible routes for swords, arsenals, Devil Hearts, Blue Orbs, and Secret Missions.

roadmap.title: DMC2 Hard routes, Trish, and upgrades
roadmap.description: Clear Hard with Dante and Lucia, use Mission Select for S ranks and Red Orb farming, then clear Must Die with Trish on Lucia's shorter campaign.

roadmap.title: DMC2 Bloody Palace
roadmap.description: Load the completed Must Die save as Trish, enable the documented infinite-Devil-Trigger mode, and pass floors 1000, 5000, and 9000 in one session.

roadmap.title: DMC3 Dante Normal and collectibles
roadmap.description: Clear DMC3 Normal in Gold Orb mode, defeat every story boss, enter all three Jester portals, and collect Secret Mission and Blue Orb progress.

roadmap.title: DMC3 Vergil Yellow run and difficulty chain
roadmap.description: Clear Easy in Yellow Orb mode with Vergil, then take Dante through Hard, Very Hard, Dante Must Die, and Heaven or Hell.

roadmap.title: DMC3 ranks, Bloody Palace, and final upgrades
roadmap.description: Use Mission Select and the unlocked super costumes to finish all S ranks, max Dante's equipment and styles, and clear Bloody Palace.

achievements.description: DMC2: Finish the game on Normal Mode with any character
achievements.summary: Finish Dante's 18-mission or Lucia's 13-mission Devil May Cry 2 campaign on @mechanic{Normal}.

guide.context: Dante and Lucia use separate saves, and both Normal campaigns must be cleared before Hard becomes available.

steps.text: Select Dante or Lucia and complete that character's full Normal campaign.
Finish the ending to receive the Normal-clear achievement, then clear the other character's Normal route for progression.

achievements.description: DMC2: Finish the game on Hard Mode with any character
achievements.summary: Finish Dante's or Lucia's Devil May Cry 2 campaign on @mechanic{Hard}.

guide.context: Hard unlocks only after both Normal campaigns, and both Hard campaigns are required before Must Die appears.

steps.text: Clear Normal with both Dante and Lucia.
Complete either character's full Hard campaign for the achievement, then finish the other Hard route to unlock Must Die.

achievements.description: DMC2: Finish the game on Must Die Mode with any character
achievements.summary: Finish a full Devil May Cry 2 campaign on @mechanic{Must Die}.

guide.context: Must Die unlocks only after both characters clear Hard; Lucia's 13-mission route is shorter than Dante's 18 missions.

steps.text: Clear Hard with both Dante and Lucia.
Select Lucia's Must Die campaign with Trish or Lucia and complete all 13 missions.

achievements.description: DMC2: Finish the game on any difficulty with Trish
achievements.estTime: stacks with Must Die or 2-3 hours
achievements.summary: Finish either Devil May Cry 2 campaign while playing as @npc{Trish}.

guide.context: Dante's Hard clear unlocks Trish on both campaign saves; using Trish for Lucia's Must Die route combines two achievements.

steps.text: Clear Dante's campaign on Hard to unlock Trish.
Select Trish on Lucia's Must Die campaign or either Normal campaign.
Complete every mission and finish the ending as Trish.

achievements.description: DMC2: Complete a Secret Mission
achievements.summary: Complete one Devil May Cry 2 Secret Mission.

guide.context: Secret Mission numbering follows the order in which entrances are used; Dante's first entrance appears in Mission 1.

steps.text: In @loc{Dante Mission 1}, continue until the first Puia bird introduction.
At the split with a large door ahead and a path left, inspect the large door and clear the Secret Mission.

achievements.description: DMC2: Pass 1000 levels in Bloody Palace Mode
achievements.summary: Pass floor 1000 in one Devil May Cry 2 Bloody Palace run.

guide.context: Bloody Palace cannot be saved; from floor 1000 onward enemies use Must Die behavior. A legitimate run is safest with a maxed Trish, Aerial Heart, Healing Heart, and several Vital and Devil Stars.

steps.text: Finish both Dante's and Lucia's campaigns on Normal to unlock Bloody Palace, then clear Dante's campaign on Hard to unlock @npc{Trish} and select Bloody Palace from the Devil May Cry 2 main menu with her.
Equip @item{Aerial Heart} and @item{Healing Heart}, maximize Trish's health and Devil Trigger gauges, and bring Vital Stars, Devil Stars, and a Yellow Orb.
Use Trish's ranged attacks and Air Raid, approach dormant Sargassos to activate them, and choose the +100 green portal after each cleared room.
Continue in the same session until floor 1000 has been passed.

achievements.description: DMC2: Pass 5000 floors in Bloody Palace Mode
achievements.summary: Pass floor 5000 in one Devil May Cry 2 Bloody Palace run.

guide.context: Bloody Palace cannot be saved; from floor 1000 onward enemies use Must Die behavior. A legitimate run is safest with a maxed Trish, Aerial Heart, Healing Heart, and several Vital and Devil Stars.

steps.text: Finish both Dante's and Lucia's campaigns on Normal to unlock Bloody Palace, then clear Dante's campaign on Hard to unlock @npc{Trish} and select Bloody Palace from the Devil May Cry 2 main menu with her.
Equip @item{Aerial Heart} and @item{Healing Heart}, maximize Trish's health and Devil Trigger gauges, and bring Vital Stars, Devil Stars, and a Yellow Orb.
Use Trish's ranged attacks and Air Raid, approach dormant Sargassos to activate them, and choose the +100 green portal after each cleared room.
Continue in the same session until floor 5000 has been passed.

achievements.description: DMC2: Pass 9000 floors in Bloody Palace Mode
achievements.summary: Pass floor 9000 in one Devil May Cry 2 Bloody Palace run.

guide.context: Bloody Palace cannot be saved; from floor 1000 onward enemies use Must Die behavior. The infinite-Devil-Trigger setup shortens the floor-9000 route from roughly five to eight hours to under an hour.

steps.text: Finish both campaigns on Normal, both campaigns on Hard, and one campaign on Must Die; Dante's Hard clear unlocks @npc{Trish}, and the finished Must Die save receives a gold medal.
At the HD Collection's outer main menu, change the language from English to a European language, launch Devil May Cry 2, and load the gold-medal Must Die save with Trish selected.
At Mission Select, hold @mechanic{RB + RT + LB + LT} while choosing Bloody Palace; confirm the code worked when Trish enters floor 1 with a full Devil Trigger gauge.
Equip @item{Aerial Heart}, remain in Devil Trigger, use Air Raid, approach dormant Sargassos to activate them, and choose the +100 green portal after each cleared room.
Continue in the same session until floor 9000 has been passed.

achievements.description: DMC2: Achieve an S Rank on any Mission with Dante
achievements.summary: Earn an overall S rank on one Devil May Cry 2 mission as @npc{Dante}.

guide.context: Normal Mission 8 is a single boss fight, so its time, damage, style, orb, and item categories are easier to control.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Dante Mission 8} on Normal with the SMGs equipped.
Shoot from mid-range, dodge close to the ring-of-fire attack without touching it to build style, and finish close enough to collect the Red Orbs.
Take no damage, use no items, and receive an overall S.

achievements.description: DMC2: Achieve an S Rank on any Mission with Lucia
achievements.summary: Earn an overall S rank on one Devil May Cry 2 mission as @npc{Lucia}.

guide.context: Normal Mission 1 balances a short route with enough enemies and Red Orbs to meet the result categories.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Lucia Mission 1} on Normal.
Finish the first skeleton wave at Show Time, skip optional fights, and collect route Red Orbs.
Defeat the mandatory golems without taking damage or using items, then receive an overall S.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Dante Mission 5} Infested Tank.

achievements.description: DMC3: Achieve an S Rank on all missions (any difficulty or character).
achievements.summary: Earn an overall S rank on all 20 Devil May Cry 3 missions on one difficulty with one character.

guide.context: Easy has the lowest thresholds. Super costumes remain eligible, and Super Sparda's unlimited Devil Trigger combined with Quicksilver simplifies cleanup.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Geryon} in Mission 12 to unlock @mechanic{Quicksilver}, clear Hard to unlock Very Hard and Dante Must Die, then clear Dante Must Die as Dante to unlock @item{Super Sparda}.
Use Easy Mission Select on the same Dante save with Super Sparda selected and Quicksilver equipped.
Avoid items, use Devil Trigger explosions on groups, taunt to rebuild Devil Trigger, and tune each route for time and Red Orbs.
Receive S on every Mission 1 through 20 result screen with the same character and difficulty.

achievements.description: DMC3: Achieve an S Rank on any mission with any character.
achievements.summary: Earn an overall S rank on any complete Devil May Cry 3 mission.

guide.context: Mission rank combines time, Red Orbs, style, damage, and item use; three S categories plus two A categories, or four S plus one A/B, are sufficient.

steps.text: Replay a familiar mission on Easy and avoid all item use.
Finish quickly, collect the required Red Orbs, maintain high combat style, and minimize damage.
Receive an overall S on the result screen.

achievements.description: DMC3: Complete Bloody Palace Mode.
achievements.summary: Clear floor 9999 and complete Devil May Cry 3 Bloody Palace in one session.

guide.context: Items and saving are disabled. Water advances 1 and restores health, Lightning advances 10 and restores Devil Trigger, and Fire advances 100 without a refill.

steps.text: Clear all 20 campaign missions on any difficulty to unlock Bloody Palace, then choose @loc{Bloody Palace} from the Devil May Cry 3 main menu and select Super Sparda with Quicksilver.
Use the +100 Fire portal while healthy; use Water or Lightning only when a refill is worth the slower advance.
Defeat the final Vergil battle on floor 9999 without ending the session.

achievements.description: DMC3: Pass 5000 levels in Bloody Palace Mode.

Continue without ending the session until floor 5000 has been passed.

achievements.description: DMC3: Complete all Secret Missions with any Character.
achievements.summary: Complete all 12 Devil May Cry 3 Secret Missions with one character.

guide.context: The entrances are in Missions 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13 twice, 16, 17, and 18; Mission Select allows cleanup.

collectibles.name: The Exorcist

collectibles.method: Enter the lower door and defeat every enemy before the one-minute timer expires.

collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 8 — tablet behind planks at the bottom of the ship's hull}

collectibles.name: Destroyer

collectibles.method: Use Nevan's Air Raid to reach the skull, then collect every Red Orb before time expires by following the airborne trail and touching the white orbs to refill Devil Trigger.

collectibles.name: Hang 10
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 11 — ledge beside the large red mural above the Devil Star}

guide.context: The first entrance appears in Mission 3 and awards a Blue Orb Fragment on the save that clears it.

steps.text: In @loc{Mission 3 — 13th Avenue}, climb to the first Blue Orb Fragment on the right ledge.
Inspect the door directly below that fragment and clear the Secret Mission.

achievements.description: DMC3: Finish the game on any difficulty as Vergil.
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 Devil May Cry 3 missions as @npc{Vergil}.

guide.context: Vergil unlocks after Dante clears Normal and uses a separate save; Easy Yellow Orb Mode satisfies two achievements in one run.

steps.text: After Dante's Normal clear, start a new Vergil save on Easy and choose @mechanic{Yellow Orb Mode}.
Complete Missions 1 through 20 and finish the ending as Vergil.

achievements.description: DMC3: Finish the game on Heaven or Hell Mode with any character.
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 Devil May Cry 3 missions on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell}.

guide.context: Every enemy and Dante die in one hit; Gold Orb Mode preserves checkpoints, while Ebony & Ivory remove most threats from range.

steps.text: Clear Dante Must Die to unlock Heaven or Hell.
Use Ebony & Ivory at range and complete Missions 1 through 20.

achievements.description: DMC3: Finish the game on Dante Must Die Mode with any character.
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 Devil May Cry 3 missions on @mechanic{Dante Must Die}.

guide.context: Enemies can activate Devil Trigger; Super Dante and stocked Vital Stars reduce the difficulty, and the clear unlocks Super Sparda and Heaven or Hell.

steps.text: Clear Very Hard and equip Super Dante on the continuing save.
Complete Missions 1 through 20 on Dante Must Die and finish the ending.

achievements.description: DMC3: Finish the game on Very Hard Mode with any character.
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 Devil May Cry 3 missions on @mechanic{Very Hard}.

guide.context: Clearing Very Hard unlocks Super Dante, whose infinite Devil Trigger helps with Dante Must Die.

steps.text: Clear Hard, then select Very Hard on the continuing Dante save.
Complete Missions 1 through 20 and finish the ending.

achievements.description: DMC3: Finish the game on Hard Mode with any character.
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 Devil May Cry 3 missions on @mechanic{Hard}.

guide.context: Normal unlocks Hard, and the Hard clear unlocks both Very Hard and Dante Must Die.

steps.text: Select Hard on the continuing Dante save.
Complete Missions 1 through 20 and finish the ending.

achievements.description: DMC3: Finish the game on Normal Mode with any character.
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 Devil May Cry 3 missions on @mechanic{Normal}.

guide.context: Reject any prompt to switch to Easy; the Normal clear unlocks Hard and Vergil.

steps.text: Start Dante on Normal in Gold Orb Mode.
Complete Missions 1 through 20 and finish the ending without changing to Easy.

achievements.description: DMC: Collect 25,000 Red Orbs
achievements.summary: Collect 25,000 cumulative @item{Red Orbs} on one Devil May Cry save.

guide.context: Red Orbs persist after saving and reloading, so repeatable enemy rooms can be farmed without finishing every run.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Mission 16}'s airplane room and defeat the Plasmas.
Leave and re-enter to respawn them, saving periodically, until the total reaches 25,000.

guide.context: The fourth fragment automatically converts the set into a permanent health upgrade on the current Dante save.

Confirm that the fourth fragment extends Dante's health bar.

achievements.summary: Max Dante's Devil May Cry health by obtaining every available Blue Orb on one continuing save.

guide.context: Health progress carries through NG+, and previously collected fragments become Yellow Orbs on later runs.

collectibles.method: Before taking the pedestal item, drop into the pit, clear the enemies, and wall-jump below the pedestal platform.

collectibles.name: Fragment 31
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 15 — glass section of the Coliseum's upper bridge}
collectibles.method: Use a side elevator and run along the very top of the bridge to its glass center.

collectibles.name: Complete Blue Orb 1
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — beside the starting elevator}
collectibles.method: Collect the complete orb before leaving the opening area.

collectibles.name: Fragment 32 — Secret Mission 9
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — Coliseum immediately after exiting it}
collectibles.method: Re-enter the Coliseum and enemy-jump from the skulls to reach the fragment; equip Alastor to avoid burning them.

collectibles.name: Fragment 33
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — Main Hall under the right staircase}
collectibles.method: Collect the fragment beneath the stairs.

collectibles.name: Fragment 34
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — air between the Main Hall horse and Divinity statues}
collectibles.method: Use Air Raid, or Stinger from the horse head or Divinity Statue, to touch the floating fragment.

collectibles.name: Fragment 35
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — circular corridor painting beside the Divinity Statue-room door}
collectibles.method: Move and jump in front of the painting until the hidden fragment appears.

collectibles.name: Fragment 36 — Secret Mission 10

collectibles.method: Return to the airplane room and defeat two Shadows there, one in the Main Hall, and one in the four-suits-of-armor room.

collectibles.name: Fragment 37

collectibles.method: Enter the right mirror and collect the fragment beside the bed.

collectibles.name: Fragment 38 — Secret Mission 11
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 17 — teleporter back to the broken bridge}
collectibles.method: Return through the teleporter, gain height with the Death Scythe or wall jumps, then use Air Raid to reach the fragment above the bridge; reset if Dante falls into the water.

collectibles.name: Fragment 39

collectibles.method: Wall-jump to the upper floor, go right, and stand at the balcony's center.

collectibles.name: Fragment 41

collectibles.method: Climb onto the tower and drop from its far side through the floating fragment.

achievements.description: DMC: Collect all Guns
achievements.summary: Collect the Shotgun, Grenade Gun, Needlegun, and Nightmare-beta on one Devil May Cry save.

guide.context: All four guns persist into NG+, so missed pickups can be recovered on a later clear.

steps.text: In @loc{Mission 2}, break the library table opposite the Rusty Key painting for the Shotgun.
In @loc{Mission 8}, take the Grenade Gun from the skeleton beside the trapdoor after lowering the drawbridge.
In @loc{Mission 12}, collect the Needlegun on the ghost ship deck near the green door.
In @loc{Mission 15}, take Nightmare-beta from the shield-door route not used for the Pair of Lances and Luminite.

achievements.displayName: The Devil Made Me Do It
achievements.description: DMC: Finish the game without using any Yellow Orbs
achievements.summary: Finish all 23 Devil May Cry missions without consuming a @item{Yellow Orb}.

guide.context: A death spends a Yellow Orb automatically when one is available, but resetting immediately prevents the use from being recorded.

steps.text: Use a developed Dante save and start a full @mechanic{Normal} playthrough.
Whenever Dante dies and a Yellow Orb is consumed, choose @mechanic{RESET} immediately and reload the latest save.
Complete Missions 1 through 23 with no Yellow Orb use recorded.

achievements.description: DMC: Clear a mission without taking damage
achievements.summary: Clear one full Devil May Cry mission without taking damage.

guide.context: Missions 2 and 5 are short, permit many enemies to be skipped, and become easier on an upgraded save.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Mission 2} or @loc{Mission 5} on a comfortable difficulty.
Skip optional fights and use stored Holy Water or Untouchable items on mandatory enemies.
Finish the mission with Dante's health bar untouched.

achievements.displayName: I Read You Like A Book
achievements.description: DMC: Unlock all the entries for every enemy file in the status menu
achievements.summary: Unlock all 147 Devil May Cry Enemy File entries on one continuing save.

guide.context: Shadow entry 8 and Sin Scythe behavior are best recorded on Normal; Blade entries 5 and 7 may require a Yellow Orb to preserve a witnessed finishing move.

collectibles.name: Marionette and Bloody Marionette — 7 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Early castle missions}
collectibles.method: Encounter and kill one; leave the matching weapon variants alive to witness the shotgun, dagger, and blade throws, then remain close without Devil Trigger for the leap-grab and immobilizing war cry.

collectibles.name: Sin Scissors — 7 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Castle and Secret Mission 1}
collectibles.method: Encounter and kill one, strike its cape, witness its descending attack, perform the two-part critical hit by opening its scissors with Alastor and shooting its face point-blank, and let a group circle rapidly around Dante.

collectibles.name: Sin Scythe — 12 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Normal Mission 16 — castle exterior after the Coliseum}
collectibles.method: Encounter and kill one; strike its cape; witness, evade, sword-parry, and Devil-Trigger-shoot its thrown scythe; wait for its umbrella, allow the follow-up grab, let a group circle Dante, shoot its head, and perform a point-blank critical hit after stunning a vertical scythe throw with Alastor.

collectibles.name: Death Scissors — 9 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Castle encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter one; try to escape its electric barrier; witness the screw attack and red-glowing attack tell; fight it in the air with Alastor, shoot its head, jump-slash its horns, strike its cape, and hit its scissors with Alastor.

collectibles.name: Death Scythe — 7 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 11 and later encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter one; witness its descending attack; enter and jump inside its black tornado; wait until it controls four scythes; strike its cape; and stun its scythe with Devil-Triggered Alastor.

collectibles.name: Shadow — 8 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Normal Mission 4 courtyard}
collectibles.method: Encounter one; strike its shadow form with non-Devil-Triggered Alastor; witness ground spears, the air spin, and the fired spear; expose and shoot its core; then stand on the fired spear and shoot until Shadow turns red.

collectibles.name: Beelzebub — 6 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Castle sewer encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter both blue and green variants, get hit by blue vomit, let a green one feed on a corpse, turn Dante's back so a green one leaps onto him, and flip a green one onto its back.

collectibles.name: Kyklops — 3 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Outdoor and secret-mission encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter one, let it fire a rock from its mouth, and damage it.

collectibles.name: Blade — 10 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 9 outdoors and Missions 12-13 underwater}
collectibles.method: Encounter one on land and underwater; strike its shield, shoot it, witness its blood projectile, launch and juggle it with Alastor, knock it face-down and attack from above, and attack from behind. At red health, let it start both the land and underwater finishing moves; use a Vital Star during the animation or continue with a Yellow Orb after death so the entry remains saved.

collectibles.name: Sargasso — 2 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Underworld encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter one and move close enough to activate its approach behavior.

collectibles.name: Nobody — 8 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Late-game underworld encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter one; let it drain Devil Trigger; break its mask; wait for it to drop, retrieve, and throw an eyeball; remain close without Devil Trigger for its grab and jump-kick; then kill it and observe the death explosion.

collectibles.name: Fetish — 5 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Later campaign encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter one; witness its flaming-wheel throw and fire breath; remain close without Devil Trigger for its leap and immobilizing war cry.

collectibles.name: Frost — 10 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Late-game campaign encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter one; witness its slash and ice projectiles; move behind it; remain far away for the ground freeze, close for the ice spears, and at mid-range for the levitating dash; shatter a body part, let it regenerate, and damage it with Ifrit.

collectibles.name: Plasma — 7 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 castle and later encounters}
collectibles.method: Encounter the bat and humanoid forms; witness the bat's electric blades and the humanoid beam; damage the humanoid without killing it until it clones; then shoot it with Nightmare-beta and strike it with Alastor.

collectibles.name: Phantom — 7 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Missions 3, 4, and 8}
collectibles.method: Encounter Phantom; attack his open mouth; remain close for the tail attack; stay away for fire pillars; witness the frontal fireball and later back-fired fireballs; and jump onto his back to attack.

collectibles.name: Nelo Angelo — 8 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Three Nelo Angelo battles, ending in Mission 17}
collectibles.method: Encounter him; witness the energy ball, sword slash, teleport, and Stinger; in Mission 17, wait for the levitating blade summon, shoot the summoned guard blades with the Grenade Gun, then defeat him and collect the pendant.

collectibles.name: Griffon — 9 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{Griffon battles, especially Missions 12 and 15}
collectibles.method: Encounter Griffon; witness horizontal electric lines, the airborne energy ball, red lightning columns, the long-range head charge, falling energy balls, and the talon dive; in Mission 12, wait for the electric-wing attachment and the landed energy-absorption lightning attack.

collectibles.name: Nightmare — 14 entries
collectibles.location: @loc{All three Nightmare battles, ending in Mission 20}
collectibles.method: Encounter Nightmare; shoot it with Nightmare-beta; witness armored and slime forms; let the slime engulf Dante; observe the rapid blue beams, later boomerang, side spears, white core-opening light, slime worms, homing core projectiles, freezing beam, exposed core, and Devil Trigger drain. In Mission 20, stand below Nightmare when it climbs onto the ceiling so its net captures Dante.

collectibles.name: Mundus — final entry
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 22 — Mundus battle}
collectibles.method: Reach the mandatory Mundus encounter on the same continuing save, then confirm all 147 paragraphs under Status -> Files -> Enemy Files.

achievements.description: DMC: Unlock 50% of all entries for every enemy file in the status menu
achievements.summary: Unlock at least 50% of all 147 Devil May Cry Enemy File entries on one save.

guide.context: Entries are awarded for witnessing attacks and weaknesses as well as meeting enemies, and progress persists through NG+.

steps.text: Leave each enemy alive long enough to perform several distinct attacks and test different weapon reactions.
Check @loc{Status -> Files -> Enemy Files} until at least half of all paragraphs are open.

achievements.description: DMC: Unlock every enemy file in the status menu
achievements.summary: Encounter every Devil May Cry enemy type so every Enemy File appears in the Status menu.

guide.context: This checks file presence rather than all 147 paragraphs; Normal contains every required category, including Sin Scythe, which does not appear on Hard.

steps.text: Complete Normal Missions 1 through 22 on one Dante save, fighting each mandatory regular enemy and boss through the Mundus battle.
Before leaving Normal, fight a @enemy{Sin Scythe} outside the Coliseum in Mission 16; use the Ifrit gate to respawn the group if its file did not register.
Open @loc{Status -> Files -> Enemy Files} and confirm all 19 categories are present on that continuing save.

achievements.summary: Earn an overall S rank on one complete Devil May Cry mission.

guide.context: Mission 13 is a short option because only the first two Blades must be killed before the remaining underwater enemies can be bypassed.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Mission 13} on a comfortable difficulty.
Defeat the first two Blades, swim past the rest, avoid damage and item use, and collect nearby Red Orbs.
Finish quickly enough to receive S on the result screen.

achievements.description: DMC: Complete all Secret Missions
achievements.summary: Complete all 12 Devil May Cry Secret Missions on one continuing save.

guide.context: Entrances appear in Missions 3, 4, 4, 4, 7, 11, between 13/14, 15, 16, 16, 17, and 21; completions persist through NG+.

collectibles.name: Critical Hit
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 3 — water below the broken bridge after defeating Phantom}
collectibles.method: Return to the bridge, drop into the water, open the Sin Scissors' blades with Alastor, and fire the Shotgun point-blank into its face.

collectibles.name: Phantom Baby
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4 — Cathedral behind the statue door at mission start}
collectibles.method: Return to the Cathedral with handguns equipped and shoot 100 Phantom Babies before time expires.

collectibles.name: Phantom Baby II
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4 — Divinity Statue room after completing Phantom Baby}
collectibles.method: Enter the room at the end of the circular hall and stomp the Phantom Babies without using weapons.

collectibles.name: Three Beasts
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4 — airplane-room elevator after defeating the courtyard Shadow}
collectibles.method: Return through the circular hall, activate the elevator switch by the airplane, and defeat all three Shadows; if Dante dies, reset immediately without saving to preserve the entrance.

collectibles.name: One-Eyed Evil
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 7 — Rusty Key room below the bedroom tower}
collectibles.method: Backtrack to the room and keep both Kyklops aligned so the rocks fired by one kill the other.

collectibles.name: Wandering Ghosts
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 11 — door directly behind Dante at mission start}
collectibles.method: Turn around, enter the previous area, and enemy-jump from the passive Sin Scissors to reach the Blue Orb overhead.

collectibles.name: Water Cell
collectibles.location: @loc{Between Missions 13 and 14 — skeleton in the ghost ship Captain's cabin}
collectibles.method: Return through the ventilation shaft, inspect the Captain's skeleton, and defeat all eight Blades.

collectibles.name: Treasure of the Reaper
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 15 — skull engraving beside the waterfall elevator before the spikes}
collectibles.method: Backtrack to the waterfall, ride the elevator down, turn right, inspect the engraving, and defeat all three Shadows.

collectibles.name: Stairway of Tranquility
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — Coliseum immediately after exiting it}
collectibles.method: Re-enter the Coliseum with Alastor equipped and enemy-jump from the skulls to the Blue Orb without burning them.

collectibles.name: Shadow of Darkness
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 — airplane room after defeating Nightmare}
collectibles.method: Return to the airplane room and defeat two Shadows there, one in the Main Hall, and one in the four-suits-of-armor room.

collectibles.name: Blue Gem in the Sky
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 17 — teleporter back to the broken bridge at mission start}
collectibles.method: Cross without touching the water, gain height with the Death Scythe or wall jumps, and Air Raid to the Blue Orb over the bridge; reset immediately if Dante falls.

collectibles.name: Hidden Bangle
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 21 — hidden wall opposite the Divinity Statue}
collectibles.method: Enter the wall, keep right through the route, defeat the Nobodies and dragon, and climb to the Bangle of Time and complete Blue Orb reward.

achievements.description: DMC: Complete six Secret Missions
achievements.summary: Complete any six of Devil May Cry's 12 Secret Missions on one continuing save.

guide.context: The first six are available by Mission 11 on Normal, and successful completions carry into NG+.

steps.text: Clear Critical Hit in Mission 3; Phantom Baby, Phantom Baby II, and Three Beasts in Mission 4.
Clear One-Eyed Evil in Mission 7 and Wandering Ghosts in Mission 11.
Confirm six Secret Mission completions on the same save.

achievements.description: DMC: Complete a Secret Mission
achievements.summary: Complete one Devil May Cry Secret Mission on the continuing Dante save.

guide.context: The first entrance is available after Phantom in Mission 3 and awards a Blue Orb Fragment.

steps.text: In @loc{Mission 3}, defeat Phantom, return to the broken bridge, and jump into the water.
Strike a Sin Scissors' open blades with Alastor, then fire the Shotgun point-blank into its face for the critical kill.

achievements.description: DMC: Purchase all of Dante's Skills
achievements.estTime: after Red Orb or style farming
achievements.summary: Buy every Alastor and Ifrit action for Dante in Devil May Cry.

guide.context: Only the two primary Devil Arms count; guns, consumables, and orb upgrades are outside this achievement.

steps.text: Use any Divinity Statue and open the @mechanic{Action} list.
Buy every action under @item{Alastor} and @item{Ifrit}, then confirm neither list contains an unpurchased move.

achievements.description: DMC: Finish the game on Dante Must Die Mode
achievements.summary: Finish all 23 Devil May Cry missions on @mechanic{Dante Must Die}.

guide.context: Hard unlocks Dante Must Die; maximize health and stockpile Untouchables, Devil Stars, and Holy Water before committing to the run.

steps.text: Complete Hard on the continuing Dante save.
Select @mechanic{Dante Must Die} and finish Missions 1 through 23.

achievements.description: DMC: Finish the Game on Hard Mode
achievements.summary: Finish all 23 Devil May Cry missions on @mechanic{Hard}.

guide.context: The Normal clear immediately continues the same save into Hard while retaining purchases, currency, and items.

steps.text: Complete Normal on the continuing Dante save.
Finish Missions 1 through 23 on @mechanic{Hard}.

achievements.description: DMC: Finish the game on Normal Mode
achievements.summary: Finish all 23 Devil May Cry missions on @mechanic{Normal}.

guide.context: A fresh save begins on Normal; accepting Easy Automatic prevents the Normal completion credit.

steps.text: Start a fresh Dante save and remain on @mechanic{Normal}.
Complete Missions 1 through 23 and finish the ending.
